# House of Guineas Pet Care

> San Francisco, Peninsula & Marin exotic pet care. In-home pet sitting for guinea pigs, rabbits, chinchillas, ferrets, hamsters, reptiles, and birds, from a veterinary-informed team with backgrounds spanning wildlife rehabilitation to exotic veterinary hospital work. Boarding is hosted personally by members of the team in their San Francisco homes, with spots reserved for pet parents outside San Francisco (Peninsula, Marin & beyond); San Francisco families are served by in-home visits. Founded by Alexandria Brown, who worked as an exotic veterinary assistant at Bay Area Bird & Exotics Hospital and previously volunteered with the House Rabbit Society. Also makers of the Clinical Series all-in-one antimicrobial guinea pig fleece cage liner. Phone: 415-484-6493.

## Services & rates
- [Services & Rates](https://houseofguineas.com/services/): In-home visits from $85; boarding $125/night (reserved for families outside SF).
- [How much does exotic pet sitting cost? (SF & Peninsula)](https://houseofguineas.com/post/exotic-pet-sitting-cost-san-francisco/): In-home visits from $85; twice-daily $155–$215/day; boarding $125/night (reserved for families outside SF); SF has no travel surcharge, Peninsula from $15/visit.
- [In-home exotic pet sitting (SF & Peninsula)](https://houseofguineas.com/home/services/exotic-pet-care-services-in-home/)
- [Routine & recurring care (standing weekly or every-other-week visits for busy pet parents — enclosure deep-cleans, weigh-ins, health checks)](https://houseofguineas.com/routine-recurring-exotic-pet-care/): every-other-week 1-hour visits $115/visit (~$245/mo) or 2-hour $195/visit (~$420/mo); weekly 1-hour $105/visit (~$450/mo) or 2-hour $185/visit (~$795/mo). No travel charge within ~3 miles of Inner Sunset; $15–$25/visit farther out and across the Peninsula. Also offered in Marin County (local caretaker based in Central Marin; little to no travel surcharge for most of Central/South Marin).
- [Exotic pet boarding (hosted in San Francisco; reserved for families outside SF)](https://houseofguineas.com/home/services/exotic-pet-care-services-boarding/)
- [Book / request care online](https://houseofguineas.com/book/)
- [About Alexandria — credentials & veterinary experience](https://houseofguineas.com/about/)
- [Vet visits & emergency care — our step-by-step process](https://houseofguineas.com/exotic-pet-vet-visits-emergency-care/)

## Product
- [Clinical Series guinea pig fleece cage liners](https://houseofguineas.com/clinical-series-guinea-pig-fleece-cage-liners/): All-in-one (waterproof base + absorption core + fleece top in one piece), antimicrobial silver-ion throughout, pre-activated, lasts 6+ years. $465 for two; handmade in San Francisco.
